name: Mind One
description: Mind One gobierna los datos de negocio que antes guardabas en Excel. Con esta integración, Claude puede crear y mantener hojas de datos (datagrids) con esquema definido, organizarlas en colecciones (datagroups) dentro de workspaces, y usar listas de valores reutilizables para mantener catálogos consistentes en toda la organización. Convierte hojas sueltas y descontroladas en datos estructurados, auditables y accesibles desde el chat.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Mind One to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Mind One to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.getmindapp.io/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Mind One MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Mind One lists 27 MCP tools, including mindone_create_datagrid, mindone_create_datagroup, mindone_create_value_list, mindone_create_workspace, mindone_delete_datagrid, mindone_get_account, mindone_get_datagrid, mindone_get_datagroup, mindone_get_job_status, mindone_get_value_list, mindone_get_workspace, and mindone_insert_rows.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Mind One?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Mind One in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.

_published_faq.name: Does Mind One MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Mind One requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Mind One is developed by Mind Analytics SL. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
